# Mathematical Derivation

$$
\text{Assume }m=365,\; n\le m.
$$

$$
\Pr(\text{all distinct})
= \frac{m}{m}\cdot\frac{m-1}{m}\cdot\frac{m-2}{m}\cdots\frac{m-(n-1)}{m}
= \frac{(m)_n}{m^n}.
$$

$$
\boxed{\Pr(\text{at least one match})
= 1 - \frac{(m)_n}{m^n}}
\quad\text{(exact).}
$$

$$
\ln\Pr(\text{all distinct})
= \sum_{k=0}^{n-1}\ln\!\Big(1-\frac{k}{m}\Big)
\approx -\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}\frac{k}{m}
= -\frac{n(n-1)}{2m}.
$$

$$
\Pr(\text{all distinct}) \approx \exp\!\left(-\frac{n(n-1)}{2m}\right)
\;\Rightarrow\;
\boxed{\Pr(\text{at least one match})
\approx 1 - \exp\!\left(-\frac{n(n-1)}{2m}\right)}
\quad\text{(approx).}
$$

$$
\text{With } m=365:\quad
\Pr(\text{match}) = 1 - \frac{(365)P_n}{365^n}
\;\approx\; 1 - \exp\!\left(-\frac{n(n-1)}{730}\right).
$$

# Reformulation


$$
\Pr(\overline{A}) = \frac{365 P_n}{365^n}
= \frac{365!}{(365-n)!\,365^n}.
$$

$$
\log \Pr(\overline{A})
= \log(n!) + \log \binom{365}{n} - n\log 365.
$$

$$
\Pr(A) = 1 - \Pr(\overline{A}) = 1 - \exp\!\Big(\log(n!) + \log \binom{365}{n} - n\log 365\Big).
$$
$$
\log \Pr(\overline{A})
= \operatorname{lfactorial}(n) + \operatorname{lchoose}(365, n) - n \log(365).
$$

$$
\Pr(\overline{A})
= \exp\!\Big( \operatorname{lfactorial}(n) + \operatorname{lchoose}(365, n) - n \log(365) \Big).
$$

$$
\Pr(A)
= 1 - \Pr(\overline{A})
= 1 - \exp\!\Big( \operatorname{lfactorial}(n) + \operatorname{lchoose}(365, n) - n \log(365) \Big).
$$




# Body of the function

  1 - (exp(lchoose(365,n) + lfactorial(n) - n*log(365)))
